predicate_sql: NOT regexp_matches(lower(regexp_replace(CAST(bdc_investment_identifier AS VARCHAR), '\s+[0-9]+$', '')), 'loan|notes?( |$)|units?( |$)|stock|shares?( |$)|interests?( |$)|warrants?( |$)|equity|certificates?|bonds?( |$)|debentures?|membership|preferred|common|partnership|participation rights|catalog of') AND TRY_CAST(principal_amount AS DOUBLE) IS NULL AND TRY_CAST(shares_held AS DOUBLE) IS NULL AND TRY_CAST(fair_value AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL

evidence.quote: Fund sandbox 'five3' (2026-10-06): in 13 of 15 quarters 2022-09-30 to 2026-03-31 the rows selected by the predicate (identifier with no instrument word, no principal, no units, a fair value) sum to the published-basis excess over fund_financials investments_at_fair_value to within 400,000. Largest selected rows: 2025-12-31 'Implus Footcare, LLC, Implus Holdings, LLC, and Implus Topco, LLC' 82,200,000; 2024-09-30 'Visual Edge Technology, Inc.' 78,700,000; 2025-03-31 'VPROP Operating, LLC and V SandCo, LLC' 56,700,000; 2025-06-30 'VPROP Operating, LLC and V SandCo, LLC' 49,100,000.

Selected rows repeat schedule positions under a different issuer-group name or as their sum: 2025-03-31 'Adonis Acquisition Holdings LLC and Adonis Acquisition Holdings Parent LLC' 24,800,000 beside its Common units 13,200,000 and two first lien loans 10,700,000 and 1,000,000; 2024-09-30 'Visual Edge Technology, Inc.' 78,700,000 beside the 'Visual Edge Technology, Inc., VEIT, LLC, and VEIT Topco, LLC' positions.

0001287750-25-000020 (10-Q, 2025-03-31): context c-1822 carries InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue 56,700,000 on the identifier 'VPROP Operating, LLC and V SandCo, LLC' (issuer names only); the schedule positions are contexts c-1694 to c-1698 (four first lien loans and Class A units).

rationale: The filer tags issuer-level fair values (controlled and affiliated company tables) with the investment identifier axis, using the issuer names alone. Most are recognised as issuer subtotals; those whose issuer-group name differs from the schedule's, or whose sum is a rounding step away, entered holdings as extra positions. Schedule rows end with the instrument and carry principal or units. The rule is structural and covers every quarter; it replaces the quarter-pinned rules exclude_2025q3_issuer_subtotals and exclude_prg_rollup_2023q2 in mechanism (they are left in place). Known residual: at 2025-03-31 and 2025-06-30 the fund is then about 94,500,000 and 33,400,000 below the filed total, because some schedule positions carry no fair value on their own context (for example the VPROP Class A units: 11,500,000 is tagged on the issuer-name axis, context c-1699). The issuer-level rows were masking that. Authored in an interactive session and checked by fund-sandbox reconciliation, not by the fleet promotion gate.
